purpose: Evaluate three preregistered small-integer FaaSRank-majority ordinal ensembles on the fresh E51-E55 low-load development cohort. All nine baselines and all three candidates complete before any performance result is read.

fresh_development_cohort.reason: E51-E55 were present only as unused reserve seeds in the V27 full source and have never been captured, referenced, executed, or inspected. E21-E50 are closed to further tuning; E04-E10 remain unused; E11-E20 remain sealed confirmation seeds.

source.high_profile_note: The global frozen high profile remains 7k; V28 itself runs low only.

diagnostic_basis.reason_for_family: The equal-vote three-expert ensemble led QPR and missed the throughput leader by 0.0212 requests/ms, while frozen FaaSRank was second in throughput. V28 shifts only the same ordinal ranks toward FaaSRank through a bounded set of exact small-integer vote multiplicities. No continuous or fitted weight is introduced.

candidates.definition: Current-demand function order; minimize the exact 2:1:1 vote-expanded ordinal rank sum, then worst rank, then node ID.
Current-demand function order; minimize the exact 2:1 vote-expanded ordinal rank sum, then worst rank, then node ID.
Current-demand function order; minimize the exact 3:1:1 vote-expanded ordinal rank sum, then worst rank, then node ID.

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Commit this plan before capturing E51-E55. Build references serially. Complete and QC all baseline and candidate runs serially before calculating any throughput, latency, cost, QPR, ranking, or candidate comparison.

eligibility_per_candidate: all five reference builds and candidate runs pass QC and result-blind pairing
all 45 baseline runs pass QC and result-blind pairing
mean fixed-window throughput is strictly greater than every one of the nine baseline means on E51-E55
mean QPR is strictly greater than every one of the nine baseline means on E51-E55
frozen V8 middle/high E01-E03 retain first-place throughput and QPR
selection_rule: Run all three candidates completely. Among candidates passing every gate, freeze the first in fixed priority v28a, v28b, v28c. Ties with a baseline do not pass. If none passes, select none, close E51-E55 permanently, do not subdivide or retune this family on those seeds, and keep confirmation sealed.

confirmation.closure_requirement: For every load, optimized NSESche must rank first in mean fixed-window throughput and QPR against frozen E11-E20 baselines; otherwise report not closed without seed deletion or confirmation-set tuning.
